Territorial Cup 2026 in Tucson: ASU at Arizona game day, parking and a road trip from the Valley

A Territorial Cup road trip with Scottsdale Sprinters starts with the schools’ own date, the group and a rider count. Fan crews and alumni lead with the Party Bus (28 Pax) or a Limo Party Sprinter; families take the Executive Sprinters, alcohol-free; VIP guests ride the Maybach Jet Sprinter. This guide uses only facts Arizona Athletics and Sun Devil Athletics publish, and turns the day into a written pickup, drop-off and ride home.

Last updated: September 27, 2026

Prices start at $125 an hour for the Luxury SUV (Suburban), which seats 6, on a 4-hour minimum, so the shortest booking is $500 before 8% tax. Every vehicle is booked by the hour at its published rate and minimum, with no per-seat pricing.

When is the 2026 Territorial Cup, and what time is kickoff?

The 2026 Territorial Cup is Arizona State at Arizona on Saturday, November 28, 2026, at Casino Del Sol Stadium in Tucson, the 100th Territorial Cup and Arizona’s Senior Day; the kickoff time is not announced yet, because both schools say game times are selected later for television, so we set the pickup once it is. Arizona’s schedule lists the game as “TBA” and the 2026 regular-season finale for both teams. Its schedule release adds that select Saturday games may be moved to a Friday, another special date or Black Friday, announced later, so check the date and the kickoff on the schools’ own schedules before the pickup is set. The game is a Big 12 Conference game. Sun Devil Athletics lists it as “@Arizona” on November 28, and Arizona Athletics as its home game against Arizona State.

Where do you park for ASU at Arizona, and where is the drop-off?

Casino Del Sol Stadium’s rideshare drop-off and pick-up is lot 4063, just north of Flandrau, and drivers park in campus lots and garages that take cards only; a chauffeured group skips the lot: we unload where stadium and traffic staff direct and meet the group again at the pickup point agreed in advance. Arizona Athletics says every surface lot is credit only and every garage takes credit cards or tap only. It lists game-day parking in named garages and lots around campus, free garage parking for carpools of four or more in four named garages, and Cat Tran shuttles from the Park Ave. Garage that start two hours before kickoff and drop fans on 6th Street, immediately south of the stadium. ADA drop-off is at the Cherry Avenue pull-out at Cherry and University, at Highland and 6th Street, on 4th Street west of Highland Avenue, and on 6th Street just south of the stadium. No drop-off zone for charter vehicles, limos or party buses is printed, so a chauffeured group is unloaded where stadium and traffic staff direct. With a chauffeur, the long drive and the parking question both go away: nobody drives the interstate home after the game, and nobody walks back to a garage.

Can you tailgate at the Territorial Cup in Tucson?

Tailgating on the University of Arizona mall needs a season or game-specific tailgate pass displayed on the vehicle, and Arizona Athletics lists the 2026 passes as sold out; groups without a pass can walk to the free Bear Down Bash on Bear Down Field, just north of the stadium, which opens three and a half hours before kickoff. The tailgating area opens six hours before kickoff, its entrance closes three hours before kickoff, all tailgating stops at kickoff, and the grounds are cleared within an hour after the game. Large parties must meet outside the area and arrive together to be parked together. Tailgating (beer and wine allowed) is also permitted in the 4052 surface lot, where a tailgate permit or a game-day fee is required to park; it is not allowed in any garage. The university’s alcohol rules on the tailgate grounds: bring your own beer and wine only, no hard alcohol, no kegs and no glass, only in the six hours before kickoff, and no alcohol inside the stadium. Those are the university’s rules for its grounds; we sell no alcohol. The Bear Down Bash is free for Wildcat fans, with live music, food trucks and a bar, and closes half an hour before kickoff. Arizona’s list for November 28 reads “Country Night”.

What is the clear bag policy at Casino Del Sol Stadium?

Arizona Athletics allows clear plastic or vinyl bags no larger than 12 by 6 by 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags, and small clutch bags about the size of a hand, which are searched; backpacks, purses larger than a clutch, fanny packs, diaper bags and cooler bags are not allowed, and no food or drink containers go in but sealed plastic water bottles. Exceptions are made for medically necessary items after inspection. Prohibited bags may not be carried inside a clear bag to get in. There is no re-entry: once you leave the stadium, you need a new ticket to return. On a road trip with us, the bags, the cooler and the jackets stay in the vehicle until the ride home.

What is the Territorial Cup, and why is it called the Duel in the Desert?

The Territorial Cup is the trophy of the Arizona State and Arizona football rivalry, also known as the Duel in the Desert; it was first awarded in 1899 in the Arizona Territory, and both schools call it the nation’s oldest rivalry trophy game, recognized by the NCAA as the oldest rivalry trophy in college football. Sun Devil Athletics writes that the Arizona Normal School, now ASU, won the first Territorial Cup game on November 30, 1899, beating the University of Arizona 11-2 in Tucson, and that the two teams have met every year since 1946. The original cup disappeared for decades and was found again in the early 1980s. Since 2001 it has travelled as a shared trophy, displayed each year by the winner. Arizona Athletics calls the November 28, 2026 game the 100th Territorial Cup.

What time do the gates open, and how does the day run?

Arizona Athletics’ general timeline runs from kickoff: tailgate lots open six hours before, the ticket office windows five hours before, the Bear Down Bash three and a half hours before, the Wildcat Walk two and a half hours before, and the Casino Del Sol Stadium gates an hour and a half before kickoff. Arizona Athletics notes that times are subject to change depending on the start time of the game. Once the kickoff is announced, the timeline falls into place, and so does your pickup time in the Valley. For a road trip, that means leaving the Valley early enough for the drive, the pregame you want and the walk to the gates, and a ride home that starts after the final whistle.

What does a chauffeured Territorial Cup road trip cost?

A game day from Scottsdale or Phoenix is booked by the hour at each vehicle’s published rate, from pickup to drop-off, with the vehicle waiting in Tucson: the Party Bus (28 Pax) is $250/hr and seats 28, a Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) is $175/hr, the Executive Black Sprinter is $145/hr; prices are before tax, and game tickets are sold by the schools. Long days cost less per hour: a 12-hour game day bills 10 hours, the free hours taken off automatically. 28 riders sharing the Party Bus (28 Pax) for 12 hours is about $89 each before tax; 14 riders in the Executive Black Sprinter is about $104 each. That is arithmetic on the published rates, not a flat game-day fare. On an hourly day the stops are yours and the miles are not counted. The ready-made packages on this page are priced the same way, with the extras they carry, and show the total before anyone books.

Which vehicle fits a Territorial Cup group?

Fan crews and alumni lead with the Party Bus (28 Pax), our pick for the road trip, or a Limo Party Sprinter; families and parents take the Executive Black Sprinter or the white Executive Sprinter, alcohol-free; VIP guests and boosters ride the Maybach Jet Sprinter; a big alumni club takes the Mini Bus, the Mini Coach or the coach. The table uses current published names, seated capacities, hourly rates and minimums, in four groups. Crews: the Party Bus (28 Pax), the Limo Party Sprinter (16 Pax) and the Limo Party Sprinter (12-13 Pax). Families: the Executive Black Sprinter and the Executive White Sprinter. VIP: the Maybach Jet Sprinter, the Ultra Luxury Party Sprinter, the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter and the Luxury SUV (Suburban). Alumni clubs: the Mini Bus (24 Pax), the Executive Mini Coach (29 Pax) and the 56-Passenger Motorcoach. A VIP party larger than the Maybach Jet Sprinter rides in two vehicles, one booking each for the same day and times: the Maybach Jet Sprinter with the Maybach Shuttle Sprinter seats 17, and with the Luxury SUV (Suburban) it seats 15. Students often ride with the group, so our house rule applies: If even one passenger is under 21, the trip is alcohol-free for the whole group, adults included. Families ride the Executive Sprinters, never a party unit, and no package on this page carries a drink service.

How far ahead should you book, and what if the date or kickoff changes?

Send the group, the pickup address and a likely passenger count as soon as you know you are going; availability varies by vehicle on a rivalry weekend, so no fixed lead time applies, and the pickup time is set once the kickoff is announced. If the schools move the game to another date, tell us the new one as soon as it is announced, and we check the vehicle for that day. The first request needs the game day, the pickup address in the Valley, the group size and who is riding: a fan crew, a family with students, VIP guests or an alumni club. During the final 48 hours, confirm addresses, phone numbers and the pickup point for the ride home. Reach the reservations team at (623) 986-6339 or reservations@scottsdalesprinters.com.

Frequently asked questions

When is the 2026 Territorial Cup?

Saturday, November 28, 2026: Arizona State at Arizona, at Casino Del Sol Stadium in Tucson. Arizona calls it the 100th Territorial Cup.

What time is the ASU vs Arizona football game?

The kickoff is not announced yet. Both schools say game times are selected later for television; check the schools’ schedules before you set a pickup.

Where is the 2026 Territorial Cup played?

At Casino Del Sol Stadium, Arizona’s home stadium on the University of Arizona campus in Tucson.

Why is it called the Duel in the Desert?

It is the other name of the Arizona State and Arizona football rivalry, whose trophy, the Territorial Cup, was first awarded in 1899 and is recognized as the oldest rivalry trophy in college football.

When do the gates open at Casino Del Sol Stadium?

An hour and a half before kickoff, on Arizona Athletics’ general game-day timeline. Tailgate lots open six hours before kickoff.

Where is rideshare drop-off at Casino Del Sol Stadium?

Lot 4063, just north of Flandrau. A chauffeured group is unloaded where stadium and traffic staff direct.

Does Casino Del Sol Stadium have a clear bag policy?

Yes. Clear bags up to 12 by 6 by 12 inches, one-gallon clear freezer bags and small clutch bags only; no backpacks, and no re-entry.

Can you hire a party bus from Scottsdale to the Territorial Cup?

Yes. The Party Bus (28 Pax), the Limo Party Sprinters and the Executive Sprinters are booked by the hour for the whole day, and wait in Tucson for the ride home. If anyone aboard is under 21, the whole trip is alcohol-free.
